item.title: Hisense HMC6MBK 7-in-1 Pressure Cooker 1000W
item.description: Hisense HMC6MBK 7-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker (1000W) Simplify your cooking routine with the Hisense HMC6MBK 7-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker. It is made for efficiency, speed and safety, and this versatile appliance handles multiple kitchen functions in one compact unit, saving you both time and energy. KEY FEATURES • 7 multi-function programs: pressure cook, slow cook, steam, saute, cook rice, warm, and make soup and stew • Large capacity: a spacious interior bowl ideal for meal prep and family-sized portions • Smart heat and pressure control: even heating that preserves nutrients, natural flavours and food texture • Advanced safety system: integrated pressure control valves, lid lock mechanisms and overheat protection • Durable non-stick inner pot: scratch-resistant, easy-to-clean coating for quick clean-up • Digital interface: an intuitive control panel with preset cooking timer options • 1000W SPECIFICATIONS • Brand: Hisense • Model: HMC6MBK • Power: 1000W • Colour: Black and stainless steel • Appliance type: Multi-functional electric pressure cooker WHAT'S IN THE BOX • 1 x Hisense HMC6MBK pressure cooker main unit • 1 x non-stick inner cooking pot • 1 x steam tray or rack • 1 x rice spoon and measuring cup • 1 x user manual and warranty guide SEVEN WAYS TO COOK Instead of keeping several pots and appliances, you can do pressure cooking, slow cooking, steaming, sauteing, rice cooking, warming and soup or stew making in one pot. Tough cuts of meat, beans and stews cook faster under pressure, while slow cooking suits dishes that benefit from a gentle, long simmer. SAVE TIME AND ENERGY Pressure cooking shortens cooking time for many dishes, which can also save gas or electricity. Preset timers help you plan meals, and the warm function keeps food ready to serve. SAFE TO USE Integrated pressure control valves, a lid lock and overheat protection give peace of mind during cooking. Always follow the user manual, make sure the valve is clear and the lid is properly closed, and let the pressure release before opening. EASY CLEAN-UP The non-stick inner pot has a scratch-resistant coating that is designed to be easy to clean. Use soft utensils and a soft sponge to protect it. GOOD FOR • Busy families and working parents • Meal prep for the week • Beans, stews, soups, rice and tender meat • Small kitchens where space is limited ORDER Order the Hisense HMC6MBK pressure cooker online, pay by M-Pesa and get delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi. item.title: Abasi 5% EC Insecticide (1 Litre) 1 Litre
item.description: Abasi 5% EC (1 litre) Spider mites, thrips and leafminers are small, but they reduce yield and spoil the look of roses, tomatoes, cucumbers and French beans, which is what buyers pay for. Abasi 5% EC is an abamectin insecticide that kills by contact and stomach action and moves through the leaf (translaminar), so pests feeding on the underside are reached. It works at very low rates. KEY BENEFITS • Strong knockdown of mites and leaf-mining insects • Contact and stomach activity stops pests feeding quickly • Translaminar movement protects both leaf surfaces • Reliable on thrips and other small sucking pests • Cost-efficient: only 4 to 6 ml per 20 L knapsack TECHNICAL SPECS • Active ingredient: Abamectin 5% (50 g/L) • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • IRAC group 6: activates glutamate-gated chloride channels, causing paralysis • Pack: 1 litre (also available in 50 ml, 100 ml, 250 ml, 500 ml and 1 L) • Crops and pests: thrips, spider mites and nematode dips on roses; spider mites and caterpillars on tomatoes; leafminers and aphids on cucumbers; leafminers, thrips, spider mites and aphids on French beans MIXING AND APPLICATION DOSAGE (per 20 L knapsack) Rate: 200 to 300 ml per hectare in 1,000 L of water, which is 4 to 6 ml per 20 L knapsack. A 1-litre bottle mixes about 166 to 250 knapsacks. 1. Half-fill the knapsack with clean water. 2. Add the measured Abasi, then top up to 20 L and agitate well. 3. Spray immediately after mixing, covering the undersides of leaves where mites and thrips hide. 4. Follow the repeat interval and harvest waiting period printed on your pack. SAFETY Toxic to bees and aquatic life, so avoid spraying during flowering or near water. Wear gloves, mask and overalls. Do not eat, drink or smoke while spraying. item.title: ALONZE 50EC Abamectin Insecticide 1 Litre
item.description: ALONZE 50EC Abamectin Insecticide (25 ml, 50 ml, 100 ml, 250 ml, 1 Litre) ALONZE 50EC is an abamectin insecticide, miticide and nematicide with contact and translaminar action. It controls spider mites, thrips and leaf miners on flowers and vegetables, and nematodes in potatoes. KEY SPECIFICATIONS & FEATURES • Active ingredient: Abamectin 50 g/L • Target: Spider mites in roses and carnations; thrips and leaf miners in vegetables; nematodes in potatoes • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • Application settings: Agricultural: flowers, vegetables and potatoes MIXING & APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS 1. Dilution rate: Foliar spray: 0.15 L per hectare in 1000 L of water (3 ml per 20 L). Potato nematodes: soil drench of 240 to 300 ml per hectare in 1000 L of water. 2. Application method: Half-fill the tank with clean water, add the measured product, top up and agitate. Spray in calm weather with good coverage of leaf undersides, where mites and thrips hide. 3. Coverage: depends on the dose and spray volume on the label. Available in 25 ml, 50 ml, 100 ml, 250 ml and 1 Litre. 4. Apply at the first signs of pests, repeat after 7 days, and do not exceed 3 applications. 5. Rotate with products from other groups and keep spray away from streams, ponds and fish. SAFETY & RE-ENTRY PRECAUTIONS • Wear gloves, a mask, goggles, overalls and boots when mixing and spraying. • Pre-harvest interval: chilies, broccoli and snow peas 7 days; runner beans, tomatoes and French beans 3 days; potatoes 14 days. Do not harvest before the interval has passed. • Re-entry period: 12 hours. Keep people, children and animals out of the sprayed area until the spray has dried, and follow the re-entry and pre-harvest intervals on the label. • Keep spray and rinse water away from streams, ponds and wells. Store in the original closed container, cool, dry and locked, away from food and feed. It is meant for: Agricultural: flowers, vegetables and potatoes. How do I mix and apply ALONZE 50EC Abamectin Insecticide? Follow the dose and water volume on the manufacturer's label. Half-fill the tank with clean water, add the measured product, top up and agitate. Spray in calm weather with good coverage of leaf undersides, where mites and thrips hide. Pentagon 50EC uses lambda-cyhalothrin, a fast-acting synthetic pyrethroid, to knock these pests down quickly and protect your yield. It is an affordable choice for vegetable, flower and field crop growers. Use the dose and water volume printed on the label for your crop and growth stage. 2. Mix with water to form a milky spray liquid, as the label directs. 3. Scout your crop regularly and spray when pests reach damaging levels. 4. Avoid spraying in strong wind. Keep spray away from ponds, rivers and neighbouring crops. 5. Rotate with products that have a different mode of action, and do not spray when bees are foraging. SAFETY & RE-ENTRY PRECAUTIONS • Wear gloves, a mask or respirator, goggles, overalls and boots when mixing and spraying. • Keep people, children and animals out of the sprayed area until the spray has dried. Follow the re-entry and pre-harvest intervals on the label. • Keep spray and rinse water away from streams, ponds and wells. • Store in the original closed container, cool, dry and locked, away from food and feed. • Check for the PCPB registration number on the pack. Always read the label before use. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS What is Pentagon 50EC Insecticide used for? It controls thrips and aphids on crops, including vegetables, flowers and field crops. Always follow the crops and rates listed on the label. What is Kiua Dudu? Kiua Dudu is the local name for Pentagon 50EC, a lambda-cyhalothrin insecticide from Greenlife Crop Protection Africa. What is the active ingredient in Pentagon 50EC? Lambda-cyhalothrin at 50 g/L, in an emulsifiable concentrate (EC) formulation. How do I mix and apply Pentagon 50EC? Follow the dose and water volume on the label. Mix with water to form a milky spray liquid. Avoid spraying in strong wind and keep spray away from water sources. What is the pre-harvest interval? It is printed on the label of your pack. It is the number of days that must pass between the last spray and harvest. Is Pentagon 50EC safe to handle? Treat it as a pesticide. item.title: Zagro Ultraxide Disinfectant 1L
item.description: One sick batch can wipe out a season's profit. Zagro Ultraxide is a broad-spectrum disinfectant that combines glutaraldehyde and a quaternary ammonium compound to kill bacteria, viruses and fungi on poultry houses, pig pens, dairy parlours, equipment and vehicles. One litre makes about 150 litres of ready-to-use solution, so it costs very little per square metre. KEY BENEFITS • Broad spectrum: bacteria, viruses and fungi; tested against African Swine Fever virus at 1:100, 1:200 and 1:300 • Concentrated: 1 litre makes about 150 L at the standard farm rate • Many jobs: hatcheries, livestock buildings, wash rooms, egg stores, foot and wheel dips, vehicles • Residual activity stays stable for up to a week on treated surfaces • Pleasant smell and easy one-step mixing TECHNICAL SPECS • Active ingredients: Glutaraldehyde 150 g/L + Benzalkonium chloride 100 g/L • Manufacturer: Zagro • Pack: 1 litre • Use: veterinary and farm disinfection MIXING AND APPLICATION DOSAGE (per 20 L) • Livestock buildings, equipment, hatching and wash rooms: 1:150, about 133 ml • General strong disinfection: 1:100, about 200 ml • Egg store: 1:320, about 62 ml • Vehicles: 1:400, about 50 ml • Drinking water: 1:3000, about 7 ml One litre makes about 150 L of solution at 1:150. 1. Remove birds, animals, feed and bedding, then scrub off dung and dirt first. 2. Fill the knapsack half full, add Ultraxide, top up and mix. 3. Spray all surfaces until thoroughly wet, then let them dry before restocking. 4. For foot and wheel dips, use the building rate and refresh the solution often. SAFETY For veterinary use. Wear gloves, goggles and a mask when handling the concentrate. Avoid contact with eyes and skin. Rinse equipment after use. item.title: Absolute 375SC Systemic Fungicide 1 Litre
item.description: Absolute 375SC Systemic Fungicide (50 ml, 100 ml, 250 ml, 1 L) Absolute 375SC is a systemic fungicide that protects crops before infection and treats diseases already on the plant. Three active ingredients in one product give broad control of fungal diseases on vegetables, fruit trees, cereals and ornamentals, on commercial farms and in kitchen gardens alike. KEY SPECIFICATIONS & FEATURES • Active ingredient: Azoxystrobin 200 g/L + Difenoconazole 125 g/L + Hexaconazole 50 g/L • Target: Fungal diseases on vegetables, fruit trees, cereals and ornamentals (preventive and curative) • Formulation: Suspension concentrate (SC) • Application settings: Commercial farms, small farms, kitchen gardens and trial plots MIXING & APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS 1. Dilution rate: use the dose and water volume printed on the manufacturer's label for your crop and growth stage. 2. Application method: Mix and spray with a knapsack sprayer, early morning or late afternoon, in calm weather. Do not spray if rain is expected soon. 3. Coverage: depends on the dose and spray volume on the label. Available in 50 ml, 100 ml, 250 ml and 1 L. 4. Start the spray programme early, before disease is widespread, and keep scouting the crop. 5. If spots, mildew or rust are already visible, spray promptly: curative action works best on early infections. SAFETY & RE-ENTRY PRECAUTIONS • Wear gloves, a mask, goggles, overalls and boots when mixing and spraying. • Keep people, children and animals out of the sprayed area until the spray has dried, and follow the re-entry and pre-harvest intervals on the label. • Keep spray and rinse water away from streams, ponds and wells. Store in the original closed container, cool, dry and locked, away from food and feed. item.title: Promax 20 EC Odourless Bed Bug Insecticide
item.description: Promax 20 EC Odourless Bed Bug Insecticide (50 ml sachet) Bed bugs, called kunguni in Swahili, hide in mattress seams, bed frames and skirting boards and bite while you sleep. Promax 20 EC is a propoxur-based, odourless insecticide concentrate that you dilute and spray straight into those hiding places. It also deals with cockroaches (mende), fleas, ants and houseflies, so one sachet protects a house, hostel room, hotel room or office. KEY FEATURES • Odourless formulation suited to bedrooms and other indoor spaces • Residual action on treated surfaces, so pests that crawl across later are still affected • Multi-pest: bed bugs, cockroaches, fleas, ants and houseflies • Concentrated: 25 ml makes 1 litre of ready-to-spray liquid • Works with any hand-pump or knapsack sprayer SPECIFICATIONS • Active ingredient: Propoxur 20% w/v (carbamate insecticide) • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • Use: household and public-health crawling-insect control • Pack: 50 ml sachet, which makes 2 litres of spray • Mode of action: blocks nerve signal transmission, causing paralysis WHERE IT HELPS Bed bugs bite at night and hide by day in mattress seams, bed frames, headboards, skirting boards and cracks. Cockroaches, fleas, ants and houseflies use the same cracks and corners to travel and breed. Promax stays active on treated surfaces, so pests that crawl across them later are still affected, which helps in bedrooms, hostel rooms and offices where you cannot spray every day. MIXING RATES (FROM THE PRODUCT LABEL) • 1 litre hand sprayer: 25 ml Promax 20 EC, topped up with water to 1 litre • 5 litre garden sprayer: 125 ml, topped up to 5 litres • 20 litre knapsack: 500 ml, topped up to 20 litres • Most homes need only 1 to 5 litres; the knapsack rate is for hotels, hostels and large premises • Always confirm the rate on your pack's label before mixing HOW TO USE IT Half-fill the sprayer with clean water, add Promax, top up with water and shake well. Spray mattress seams, bed frames, headboards, skirting boards, cracks, the backs of sockets and furniture joints. Wet the surfaces lightly and do not soak them. Bed bug eggs can hatch later, so inspect after about two weeks and treat again if needed. BEFORE YOU START • Strip the bed and wash bedding at a high temperature • Vacuum the mattress, frame and floor • Do not spray food, utensils or bedding you will use before it dries SAFETY Keep children, pets and fish tanks out of the room until surfaces are dry and the room is ventilated. Wear gloves and wash your hands after use. Odourless does not mean harmless: it is still an insecticide, so keep it away from food, water and children. STORAGE Keep the sachet or any leftover concentrate sealed in its original pack, in a cool, dry, locked place. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS How much spray does one 50 ml sachet make? One 50 ml sachet makes 2 litres of ready-to-spray liquid, at 25 ml per litre. Always confirm the rate on the label of your pack before mixing. Will I smell it after spraying? The formulation is odourless, so it suits bedrooms. Let surfaces dry fully, ventilate the room and keep people and pets out until then. Does one treatment remove bed bugs? Eggs can hatch later, so inspect after about two weeks and treat again if you still see bugs. item.title: Syngenta Tatua Rat and Mice Poison Blocks
item.description: Syngenta Tatua Rat and Mice Poison Blocks (1 pack) Syngenta Tatua Rat and Mice Poison Blocks are bait blocks for rat and mice control in stores, farms, poultry houses and other premises, and they are made to be used inside bait stations. In a farm store or a poultry house, rodents eat and spoil feed and disturb the birds. A block is heavy and solid, so it resists damp and handling better than loose bait, and it can be fixed inside a station so that it is not scattered. KEY FEATURES • Bait blocks for rat and mice control • Made to be used inside bait stations • For stores, farms, poultry houses and other premises • From Syngenta Tatua • Delivered to all 47 counties SPECIFICATIONS • Brand: Syngenta Tatua • Product: Rat and mice poison blocks • Form: Bait blocks • Use: Rats and mice • Pack size: check the pack for its size WHERE IT HELPS Rats and mice contaminate and eat stored food, chew wires, sacks and packaging, and can spread disease. Rodents can carry or gnaw a block, but a block held inside a station stays where you put it. That makes it easier to see which stations are being visited and to replace only the bait that has been eaten. HOW TO USE IT Look for droppings, gnaw marks, runways and burrows to find where rodents travel. Place bait stations along walls, near holes, behind stacked goods and in dark corners, and put the blocks inside so that children, pets and livestock cannot reach them. Check the stations regularly, replace blocks that have been eaten, and move a station if there is no activity at that spot. BEFORE YOU START • Store grain, feed and produce on raised pallets, away from walls, in rodent-proof containers • Seal holes and gaps, and keep drains and doors closed or screened • Remove rubbish and clutter, and cut tall grass and bush near buildings • Have gloves ready, and plan where each station will stand SAFETY Check the PCPB registration number on the label and read the label before use. Use the blocks only inside bait stations, never on food or in food areas. Collect dead rodents with gloves, dispose of them safely and wash your hands afterwards. Keep the blocks away from children, pets and livestock. STORAGE Keep the blocks in their original pack, dry and locked away from children, pets and food. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Why are bait blocks used in stations? A block fixed inside a station is not scattered or carried off, and children, pets and livestock cannot reach it. Where should I place the stations? Along walls, near holes, behind stacked goods and in dark corners where you find droppings, gnaw marks and runways. Can I use the blocks in a poultry house? They are sold for poultry houses as well as stores and farms. Use them only inside bait stations, away from feed, drinkers and the birds. item.description: Gradometer 480EC Termiticide (1 litre) Mchwa (termites) feed on wood, paper and other plant material, and they can weaken roof timbers, door frames, fence posts and furniture before the damage is clearly visible. Gradometer 480EC is an emulsifiable concentrate termiticide containing chlorpyrifos 480 g/L, supplied in a 1 litre bottle. It is used for treating timber, trees and fencing poles, wooden structures, and termite nests in lawns and gardens. Indoors and around the home they eat into timber in buildings and construction, trees and fencing poles, and wooden structures such as sheds, posts and frames. Early treatment limits the damage and the cost of repairs. HOW TO USE IT Gradometer 480EC is an emulsifiable concentrate, so it is diluted with water as directed on the label. Use the label dilution for timber and for nests, and never mix it stronger than recommended. Treat timber thoroughly, paying attention to cut ends, joints and the places where wood touches the soil. For a nest, follow the label instructions for reaching it and treating the soil around it. BEFORE YOU START • Remove old stumps, dead wood and rotting timber from around buildings • Keep timber off the ground where possible, and keep it dry • Fix leaking pipes and drains that keep the soil damp • Inspect timber regularly for mud tubes, soft wood and flying termites SAFETY Check the PCPB registration number on the label and mix and apply exactly as directed. Wear protective gear, including gloves, a mask, goggles and protective clothing, and keep away from children, pets, food and water. Chlorpyrifos is harmful to fish and aquatic life, so keep it away from streams, ponds, wells and drains. For buildings, consider a licensed pest control operator. STORAGE Store in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry, locked place away from food and feed. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS What can I treat with Gradometer 480EC? It is used for timber in buildings and construction, trees and fencing poles, wooden structures such as sheds, posts and frames, and termite nests in lawns and gardens. Can I use it on a termite mound in my garden? It is used for treating termite nests in lawns and gardens. Follow the label instructions for reaching the nest and treating the soil around it. Does treatment replace good housekeeping? No. Remove stumps and rotting wood, keep timber dry and off the ground, fix leaks and inspect timber for mud tubes so that termites have fewer reasons to return. item.title: Bayer Baraki Pellets Rat and Mice Poison 10 g
item.description: Bayer Baraki Pellets Rat and Mice Poison, 10 g sachet Rats gnaw wiring, foul food stores and spread disease, and a few quickly become many. Bayer Baraki Pellets are a ready-to-use rodenticide bait made for single-feed control: rats and mice need to eat the bait only once. The pellets contain difethialone, an anticoagulant, and need no mixing. Baraki comes as a 10 g sachet, a 100 g pack and a 1 kg box. This listing is the 10 g sachet, the smallest Baraki pack and a low-cost way to try the bait or treat one room. At the placement amounts below, a mouse station takes about 2 sachets and a rat station about 5 to 7. KEY FEATURES • Single-feed anticoagulant bait for roof rats, Norway rats and house mice • Mould and moisture resistant, so it stays attractive in damp stores • Sold as effective against resistant strains • Suited to homes, markets, farms and industrial sites SPECIFICATIONS • Brand: Bayer • Product: Baraki Pellets Rat and Mice Poison • Type: Anticoagulant rodenticide bait pellets (difethialone) • Pack sizes: 10 g sachet, 100 g, 1 kg box WHERE IT HELPS Rodents chew wiring, sacks and packaging, eat and spoil stored food, and leave droppings and urine that spread germs. Roof rats climb into ceilings and stores, Norway rats burrow along walls and drains, and house mice nest in small hidden spaces, so the places to bait differ. Pellets that resist mould and moisture help in damp stores and farm buildings, where loose bait goes off quickly. PLACEMENT AMOUNTS (NO MIXING) • Rats: 50 to 75 g per station (about 5 to 7 sachets of 10 g), one station every 5 to 10 m along walls, rat runs, burrows and sheltered areas • Mice: 15 to 20 g per station (about 2 sachets of 10 g), one station every 2 to 4 m along walls, runways and nests • A 100 g pack is about 10 sachets of 10 g, and a 1 kg box is about 100 sachets HOW TO USE IT Inspect first for droppings, gnaw marks, runs and burrows, so you know where the rodents travel. Place the bait in covered bait stations or tamper-resistant boxes, never loose on the floor. Check every 2 to 3 days and top up until feeding stops. Wearing gloves, collect dead rodents and dispose of them safely. BEFORE YOU START • Block holes and gaps around pipes, doors and roof edges • Store grain, feed and food in closed containers, off the floor • Remove rubbish and clutter that give rodents shelter SAFETY This is a poison. Read the label before use and keep the bait out of reach of children, pets and poultry. Wear gloves and wash your hands after handling it. If a person or an animal swallows any, get medical or veterinary help immediately and show the pack. STORAGE Keep sachets and packs closed in a dry, locked place, away from food, animal feed and children. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Which Baraki pack size should I buy? The 10 g sachet suits one room or a first trial. The 100 g pack suits a shop, a store or a home with several bait points, and the 1 kg box suits farms, markets and industrial sites. item.title: Miratex Pellets Rat and Mice Killer Bait 240 g
item.description: Miratex Pellets Rat and Mice Killer Bait (20 g, 240 g) Miratex pellets are a ready-to-use bait for rat and mice control in homes, shops, kitchens, stores and farm buildings. There is no mixing: you place the pellets near nesting holes, along walls and on rat runs. The 20 g pack suits a single room, a small store or a first treatment, and the 240 g pack is made for warehouses, hotels, farms and other larger premises that need many bait points. KEY FEATURES • Pellet bait for rat and mice control • Ready to use, with no mixing • Placed near nesting holes, along walls and on rat runs • Two pack sizes: 20 g and 240 g • Delivered to all 47 counties SPECIFICATIONS • Brand: Miratex • Product: Rat and mice killer bait pellets • Use: Rats and mice • Category: Rodent control • Pack sizes: 20 g, 240 g WHERE IT HELPS Rodents usually move along walls and through dark, quiet corners. They contaminate food, chew wires, damage sacks and furniture, and can spread disease, and because they breed fast, early baiting together with good hygiene is the sensible way to protect a home, a business and stored produce. Larger buildings need bait in many places and need it topped up over time, which is what the 240 g pack is for: grain stores, feed stores, poultry houses, workshops and godowns. HOW TO USE IT Walk around first and look for droppings, gnaw marks, greasy rub marks along walls and burrows. Put bait close to those signs, along walls and near nesting holes, at points that children, pets and livestock cannot reach. Check the bait points often and replace pellets that have been eaten. Wearing gloves, remove dead rodents safely. BEFORE YOU START • Keep grain and animal feed in sealed containers, on raised pallets in stores • Block holes and gaps, and cut tall grass close to buildings • Keep rubbish and old materials away from the walls • Count the bait points you need before you choose a pack size SAFETY Check the PCPB registration number on the label and read the label before use. Place the bait where only rodents can reach it, and never near food for people or animals, or inside food containers. Keep it away from children, pets and livestock, and wash your hands after handling it. STORAGE Store the pellets in their closed pack, somewhere dry and secure, away from food and out of reach of children. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Which Miratex pack should I buy? The 20 g pack suits a single room, a small store or a first treatment. The 240 g pack suits stores, farms, warehouses and hotels that need many bait points. Do I need to mix the pellets? No. They are ready to use, so you place them directly at the bait points. Where do rats usually travel? Along walls, through dark corners and between their nest and their food. Bait close to droppings, gnaw marks and runways works better than bait in the middle of a room. item.title: Lysine Feed Amino Acid (25kg Bag)
item.description: Lysine Feed Amino Acid (25 kg) Lysine feed amino acid comes in a 25 kg bag for balancing poultry and pig rations on farms in Kenya. It is an amino acid supplement for animal feed formulation, used on farms and by feed mixers. KEY FEATURES • Amino acid supplement for animal feed formulation • For balancing poultry and pig rations • 25 kg bag for farms and feed mixers • Delivered to all 47 counties SPECIFICATIONS • Product: Lysine • Type: Feed amino acid • Pack size: 25 kg WHAT IS LYSINE? Lysine is an essential amino acid. Amino acids are the building blocks of protein, and animals cannot make lysine themselves, so it must come from the feed. In poultry and pigs, lysine is the amino acid that is most often short in cereal-based rations such as those made mostly with maize. When lysine is short, growth slows, feed conversion worsens and muscle development suffers. WHY ADD LYSINE TO RATIONS Adding lysine helps farmers and feed mixers balance rations so that animals get the amino acids they need. This can support growth, feed efficiency and meat yield in pigs and broilers, and egg production in layers. It also helps balance protein levels in feed formulations, which can help reduce the amount of protein-rich ingredients needed. WHERE IT IS USED • Poultry rations: chicks, broilers, growers and layers • Pig rations: weaners, growers and finishers The correct amount depends on the species, age, production level and the other ingredients in the ration. HOW TO USE IT Read and follow the label and inclusion rate before use. Add lysine to the ration at the rate recommended on the label or by your nutritionist or vet. Mix very thoroughly so that every animal receives an even amount, using a proper mixer or mixing in stages for small batches. Do not exceed the recommended rate. GOOD PRACTICE • Use a written feed formulation for every batch • Balance lysine with other amino acids, energy and minerals • Provide clean water at all times • Weigh ingredients carefully • Monitor growth, feed intake and animal health • Ask a nutritionist for help with formulations SAFETY Read and follow the label and inclusion rate before use. Keep away from children and pets. Avoid breathing the dust, and wash your hands afterwards. STORAGE Store in a cool, dry place off the floor, away from moisture and direct sun. Close the bag tightly after use. ORDER Order Lysine Feed Amino Acid online, pay by M-Pesa and get delivery to all 47 counties, or pick up at The Sarit Centre, Westlands, Nairobi. The 25 kg bag is made for poultry farms, hatcheries, feed mixers and agrovets who prepare feed for chickens. Pay by M-Pesa and get delivery to all 47 counties. Why Coccidiosis Prevention Matters Coccidiosis is one of the most common and costly diseases in poultry. It is caused by microscopic parasites that damage the lining of the gut, leading to bloody or watery droppings, weakness, poor growth, poor feed conversion, reduced egg production and deaths, especially in young birds raised on litter. Prevention through feed, along with good management, is far cheaper than treating an outbreak. Uneven mixing can leave some birds under-protected and expose others to too much. Observe the withdrawal period before slaughter, and do not combine it with other products unless your vet advises it. Keep the mixing equipment clean to prevent carry-over into feeds for other animals. Good Management Tips Keep litter dry, avoid overcrowding, clean feeders and drinkers regularly and keep young birds separate from older ones. Clean and rest the house between batches and talk to a veterinarian about a vaccination or feed programme that suits your farm. item.description: Weed-Out 480SL Glyphosate Herbicide (5 litres) Clearing a plot, fence line, compound or farm before planting by hand takes days and costs a lot in labour. Weed-Out 480SL is a non-selective, systemic glyphosate herbicide that is absorbed through the leaves and travels down to the roots, so grasses and broadleaf weeds die instead of regrowing. The 5-litre pack suits farmers, estate caretakers and contractors who clear land often. KEY BENEFITS • Systemic action kills the roots, which means less regrowth than slashing or hoeing • Controls annual and perennial grasses and broadleaf weeds, including tough couch grass • Saves labour on land preparation, zero-tillage planting, fence lines, paths and compounds • Economical: 5 L makes 16 to 25 knapsack loads depending on the weed • Rain-free period is short, so you can spray on the next dry morning TECHNICAL SPECS • Active ingredient: Glyphosate 480 g/L • Formulation: Soluble liquid (SL) • Type: Non-selective, post-emergence, systemic herbicide • Pack: 5 litres MIXING AND APPLICATION DOSAGE (per 20 L knapsack) • Young broadleaf weeds and annual grasses: 200 ml (5 L pack makes 25 knapsacks) • Perennial grasses such as couch grass: 300 ml (5 L pack makes about 16 knapsacks) At about 4 L per hectare in 200 L of water (200 ml per 20 L), one 5 L pack treats roughly 1 hectare. Always confirm the rate on your pack's label. 1. Use clean water. Half-fill the knapsack, add Weed-Out, then top up to 20 L and shake. 2. Spray actively growing weeds until the leaves are wet but not dripping. 3. Expect yellowing within a few days and root die-off soon after. 4. Avoid spraying if rain is expected within 4 to 6 hours. SAFETY It kills any green plant it touches, so shield crops and avoid drift in wind. Keep away from water sources. Wear gloves, overalls and a face mask. item.title: Grain-Save Dust Storage Protection (500g)
item.description: Grain-Save Dust (500 g) Grain-Save Dust is a permethrin-based protectant for stored maize and beans against weevils and other storage pests. It is mixed into dry grain at the rate printed on the label and comes in a 500 g pack suited to farmers and households storing grain. KEY FEATURES • Permethrin-based dust • Protects stored maize and beans • Works against weevils and other storage pests • Mixed into dry grain at the label rate • 500 g pack • Delivered to all 47 counties SPECIFICATIONS • Product: Grain-Save Dust • Active ingredient: permethrin (strength on the label) • Formulation: dust • Use: grain protectant for stored maize and beans • Pack size: 500 g • Rate: as printed on the manufacturer's label WHERE IT HELPS After harvest, weevils can hollow out kernels, leave dust and holes, lower germination and make grain unfit for food or sale. Treating grain as it goes into storage protects the work you put into the crop and keeps seed and food grain in good condition for longer. HOW TO USE IT Make sure the grain is properly dry before storage, because damp grain spoils even when treated. Mix the dust into the dry grain at the label rate, turning the grain thoroughly so the dust is spread evenly through every bag or heap. Follow the label's waiting period before using treated grain, and do not feed treated grain to animals unless the label allows it. Permethrin is very toxic to fish, so never rinse containers or equipment into streams, ponds or drains. STORAGE Keep the pack closed in a cool, dry, locked place away from food and feed. Regular deworming, together with good hygiene, is part of responsible pet and farm dog care. item.title: Promax 20EC Insecticide
item.description: Promax 20EC Insecticide (1 litre) Bed bugs (kunguni) hide in mattress seams, bed frames and skirting boards, then bite while you sleep. Promax 20EC is a propoxur-based, odourless insecticide concentrate that you dilute and spray straight into those hiding places. It also tackles cockroaches (mende), fleas, ants and houseflies, so one 1 litre bottle covers a house, hostel, hotel room or office. KEY FEATURES • Odourless formulation suited to bedrooms and other indoor spaces (let surfaces dry fully) • Residual action on treated surfaces, so pests that crawl across later are still affected • Multi-pest: bed bugs, cockroaches, fleas, ants and houseflies • Concentrated: 25 ml makes 1 litre of ready-to-spray liquid • Works with any hand-pump or knapsack sprayer SPECIFICATIONS • Product: Promax 20EC Insecticide • Active ingredient: Propoxur 20% w/v (carbamate insecticide) • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • Use: Household and public-health crawling-insect control • Mode of action: blocks nerve signal transmission, causing paralysis • Pack size: 1 litre WHERE IT HELPS Most homes need only a small amount of spray, so a concentrate goes a long way: one 1 litre bottle makes 40 litres of ready-to-spray liquid. Bed bugs, cockroaches, fleas, ants and houseflies are the main targets, and the residual film means that pests which crawl across a dry surface later are still affected. MIXING RATES (FROM THE PRODUCT LABEL) • 1 litre hand sprayer: 25 ml Promax 20EC, topped up with water to 1 litre • 5 litre garden sprayer: 125 ml, topped up to 5 litres • 20 litre knapsack: 500 ml, topped up to 20 litres • Most homes need only 1 to 5 litres; the knapsack rate is for hotels, hostels and large premises • Always confirm the rate on your pack's label before mixing HOW TO USE IT Half-fill the sprayer with clean water, add Promax, top up and shake well. Spray mattress seams, bed frames, headboards, skirting boards, cracks, behind sockets and furniture joints. Wet surfaces lightly; do not soak them. Bed bug eggs can hatch later, so inspect after about two weeks and treat again if needed. BEFORE YOU START • Keep children, pets and fish tanks out of the room until surfaces are dry and the room is ventilated • Do not spray food, utensils or bedding you will use before it dries SAFETY Wear gloves and wash your hands after use. Read the label before you begin, and keep the bottle out of reach of children. STORAGE Keep the bottle closed in a cool, dry, locked place, away from food. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS What is Promax 20EC used for? It is an odourless insecticide concentrate for bed bugs, cockroaches, fleas, ants and houseflies in homes, hostels, hotels and offices. What is the active ingredient? Propoxur at 20% w/v, a carbamate insecticide in an emulsifiable concentrate (EC) formulation. How do I mix it? 25 ml topped up with water to 1 litre in a hand sprayer, 125 ml to 5 litres, or 500 ml to 20 litres. Always confirm the rate on your pack's label. When should I treat bed bugs again? Bed bug eggs can hatch later, so inspect after about two weeks and treat again if needed. item.title: Premise 200 SC Termiticide 1 Litre
item.description: Premise 200 SC Termiticide (50 ml, 1 litre) Termites (mchwa) rarely announce themselves. They eat door frames, roof timbers and cupboards from the inside until the damage is expensive. Bayer Premise 200 SC is a non-repellent, odourless termiticide with imidacloprid 200 g/L. Termites walk through the treated soil without detecting it, carry the active ingredient back and spread it through the colony. KEY FEATURES • Non-repellent with a transfer effect, so it reaches termites you cannot see • Suitable for pre-construction and post-construction treatment • Also listed for controlling ants • Practically odourless at the recommended dilution • Delivered to all 47 counties SPECIFICATIONS • Brand: Premise, made by Bayer • Active ingredient: Imidacloprid 200 g/L (neonicotinoid) • Formulation: Suspension concentrate (SC) • Applications: foundations, slab preparation, trenches, termite mounds and wall voids • Pack sizes: 50 ml and 1 litre WHERE IT HELPS It suits a builder treating hardcore and soil before the slab is cast, a homeowner treating the foundation lines of an existing house, and anyone dealing with a termite mound or wall void. MIXING RATES (FROM THE PRODUCT LABEL) • Dilution: 50 ml Premise 200 SC per 20 L knapsack of water (0.25%) • Application volume: 5 L of mixed solution per m² of soil, or per linear metre of trench along foundations • One knapsack covers about 4 m² or 4 linear metres • A 1 litre bottle mixes 20 knapsacks (400 L), enough for about 80 m² or 80 linear metres HOW TO USE IT Shake the bottle vigorously, half fill the knapsack with clean water, add the measured Premise, top up to 20 L and stir. Pre-construction: treat the hardcore and soil before the slab is cast. Trenches: apply along the inside and outside of the foundation lines. Existing buildings: drill and inject along foundations and slab joints, and for a mound, drill into the nest and drench it thoroughly. Do not apply in rain or when rain is expected, and wash all equipment after use. Check the rates against the label on your pack. BEFORE YOU START • Fix leaks and remove old stumps and buried timber near the building • Keep treated soil away from wells, boreholes and drains • For a large building, consider a licensed pest control operator SAFETY Harmful. Wear gloves, overalls, boots and a mask when mixing and spraying. It is toxic to bees and aquatic life, so never let spray or wash water reach streams, ponds, wells or drains. STORAGE Store the unused product in its original, closed pack in a cool, dry, locked place, away from food, feed and children. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS How does Premise 200 SC kill the whole colony? It is non-repellent, so termites cross the treated soil without detecting it. They carry the active ingredient back and spread it through the colony. How much does one knapsack of Premise cover? Mixed at 50 ml per 20 L and applied at 5 L per m², one knapsack treats about 4 m² of soil or 4 linear metres of trench. Confirm the rates on your label. Which pack should I choose, 50 ml or 1 litre? The 50 ml pack makes one 20 L knapsack, which suits a small job. The 1 litre bottle makes twenty, which suits a house or a building site. item.title: Kerol Disinfectant Fluid (1L)
item.description: Kerol Disinfectant Fluid (1 Litre) Kerol Disinfectant Fluid has a Rideal-Walker coefficient of 18 to 20 and is a powerful disinfectant and insect repellent for livestock houses, poultry houses and domestic use. It comes in a 1 litre pack and is diluted with water as directed on the label. KEY FEATURES • Rideal-Walker coefficient 18 to 20 • Powerful disinfectant • Also acts as an insect repellent • For livestock houses, poultry houses and domestic use • Dilute with water before use • 1 litre pack • Delivered to all 47 counties WHAT THE RIDEAL-WALKER COEFFICIENT MEANS The Rideal-Walker coefficient is a traditional way of comparing the germ-killing strength of a disinfectant with phenol, which is given a value of 1. A coefficient of 18 to 20 means the fluid is many times stronger than phenol when tested under standard laboratory conditions, which is why it is described as a powerful disinfectant. Real results depend on dilution, contact time and how clean the surface is. WHERE IT IS USED • Livestock houses: cattle sheds, milking parlours, goat and sheep pens and pig sties • Poultry houses: brooders, layer and broiler houses, and equipment • Domestic use: floors, drains, toilets, bins and other places that need disinfecting WHY DISINFECTION MATTERS Germs build up where animals live and where waste collects. Regular cleaning and disinfection lowers the risk of disease spreading in a herd or flock, protects young animals, and keeps houses fresher and smell-free. In the home, it helps keep drains, bathrooms and bins clean. HOW TO USE IT Dilute with water as directed on the label, using the correct amount for the job. Always clean first: remove manure, bedding, feed and dirt, wash with water and allow to drain, because disinfectants work best on clean surfaces. Then apply the diluted fluid by spraying, mopping or scrubbing, and give it enough contact time as stated on the label before rinsing, if required. Let houses dry and rest before animals return, following the label. GOOD PRACTICE • Use clean water for dilution • Do not mix with other chemicals or cleaners • Disinfect feeders and drinkers only as directed on the label, and rinse them well • Repeat between batches of animals SAFETY Read the label before use. Wear gloves, goggles and protective clothing, and avoid contact with eyes and skin. Keep away from children, pets, food and drinking water. Do not let large amounts reach streams or ponds. STORAGE Store in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry, locked place away from food and feed. item.title: Icon 10CS Mosquito Insecticide
item.description: Syngenta Icon 10CS Mosquito Insecticide (62.5 ml) Mbu (mosquitoes) bite at dusk and through the night, and they can carry diseases such as malaria. Syngenta Icon 10CS is a long-lasting residual insecticide: you dilute it with water, spray it on the surfaces where insects rest, and it keeps working after the spray has dried. It contains lambda-cyhalothrin 100 g/L in a capsule suspension (CS) formulation and is also used against flies and cockroaches. The 62.5 ml bottle suits a house, a few rooms or a small business. KEY FEATURES • Lambda-cyhalothrin 100 g/L public health insecticide • Capsule suspension (CS) with long-lasting residual action • Controls mosquitoes, flies and cockroaches • Diluted with water and sprayed on resting surfaces • 62.5 ml pack for a house or small business • Delivered to all 47 counties SPECIFICATIONS • Brand: Syngenta • Product: Icon 10CS Mosquito Insecticide • Active ingredient: Lambda-cyhalothrin 100 g/L • Formulation: Capsule suspension (CS) • Target pests: Mosquitoes, flies and cockroaches • Pack size: 62.5 ml • Dilution: as directed on the label WHERE IT HELPS In a capsule suspension the active ingredient is held in tiny capsules in a liquid. After spraying, the capsules stay on the treated surface and release the active ingredient slowly, which is designed to give a longer-lasting residual effect than a spray that is released all at once. HOW TO USE IT Shake the bottle well, measure carefully as the label directs and mix thoroughly in clean water in the sprayer. Spray the surfaces where insects rest or walk: walls, door and window frames, eaves, shaded places, drains, and the cracks and corners where cockroaches hide. Treat the whole house in one session so insects do not move to an untreated room. For large buildings, consider a licensed pest control operator. BEFORE YOU START • Remove or cover food, dishes and water containers • Keep people and pets out of the treated rooms until the spray has dried • Clear stagnant water, rubbish and blocked drains to cut breeding sites • Fit mosquito nets and window screens for added protection SAFETY Read the label before use. Wear gloves, a mask, goggles and protective clothing when mixing and spraying, and wash well afterwards. Keep away from children, pets, food and water. Lambda-cyhalothrin is very toxic to fish and bees, so never rinse sprayers or containers into drains, streams, ponds or fish tanks. STORAGE Keep in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry, locked place away from food and feed. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS What does capsule suspension (CS) mean? The active ingredient is held in tiny capsules that stay on the treated surface and release it slowly. This is designed to last longer than a spray that acts all at once. Which insects is Icon 10CS used against? It is sold for public health insects, including mosquitoes, flies and cockroaches, in homes and small businesses. Is the 62.5 ml pack enough for my house? It is a convenient size for a house, a few rooms or a small business. A large building may need more than one pack, or a licensed pest control operator. item.title: Jambo Clean Foliar Fertilizer
item.description: Greenlife Jambo Clean Foliar Fertilizer (1 Litre) Greenlife Jambo Clean is a foliar fertilizer that cleans sooty mould and honeydew off crops while nourishing them. It contains water-soluble phosphorus pentoxide (P2O5) 8.2% and total nitrogen 10.0% (urea 8.5% plus ammoniacal 1.5%). It is supplied in a 1 litre pack. KEY FEATURES • Foliar fertilizer that cleans sooty mould and honeydew • Water-soluble phosphorus pentoxide (P2O5) 8.2% • Total nitrogen 10.0% (urea 8.5% + ammoniacal 1.5%) • Feeds the crop while it cleans the leaves • 1 litre pack • Greenlife brand • Delivered to all 47 counties WHAT ARE HONEYDEW AND SOOTY MOULD? Sucking insects such as aphids, whiteflies and scale insects feed on plant sap and pass out a sticky, sugary liquid called honeydew. It covers leaves, stems and fruits. A black fungus called sooty mould then grows on the honeydew and forms a dark coating. The coating blocks light, so the plant cannot photosynthesise well, and it makes the crop look dirty, which can lower quality and market value, especially for flowers, vegetables and fruit. HOW JAMBO CLEAN HELPS Jambo Clean is sprayed on the crop to help clean off sooty mould and honeydew. At the same time, the nutrients in the product nourish the plant. This makes it a practical choice for growers who need to clean up their crops and give them a boost. WHAT THE NUTRIENTS DO • Nitrogen supports leaf growth and green colour. Here it comes partly as urea and partly as ammoniacal nitrogen • Phosphorus supports root development, flowering and energy transfer in the plant HOW TO USE IT Follow the dose, water volume, timing and interval given on the label. Mix in clean water, agitate, and spray evenly so that leaves are well covered. Spray in the cool of the morning or late afternoon and avoid the heat of the day to reduce the risk of leaf scorch. Test on a few plants first if you are using it on a crop for the first time. IMPORTANT: TREAT THE CAUSE TOO Sooty mould returns if the sucking insects are still there. Scout for aphids, whiteflies and scale and control them with a suitable insecticide, following its label. Good crop hygiene, ant control and removing badly affected leaves also help. SAFETY Read the label before use. Wear gloves and avoid contact with eyes and skin. Keep away from children, pets, food and water. Do not let spray or rinse water reach streams or ponds. STORAGE Store in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry place away from food and feed. WHY WORM AND FLUKE CONTROL MATTERS Internal parasites reduce growth, milk and meat production, and fertility. Roundworms and lungworms cause poor condition, diarrhoea and coughing. item.description: Albafas 10% Albendazole Drench (500 ml) Albafas is a 10% w/v albendazole drench for treating worms and liver fluke in cattle, sheep, goats and camels. It is supplied in a 500 ml bottle from Norbrook Kenya, and it is used against roundworms, lungworms, tapeworms and liver fluke. KEY FEATURES • 10% w/v albendazole, a broad-spectrum dewormer • For cattle, sheep, goats and camels • Used against roundworms, lungworms, tapeworms and liver fluke • 500 ml bottle • Made by Norbrook Kenya WHY WORM CONTROL MATTERS Internal parasites quietly drain animals. Heavily infected cattle, sheep, goats and camels grow slowly, lose condition, produce less milk and meat, and become more open to other diseases. Young animals are often the most affected. Regular, well-planned deworming protects growth and productivity and can save the cost of treating sick animals later. HOW TO USE IT Albafas is given by mouth as a drench. The dose depends on the animal species and body weight, so follow the dose on the label and use an accurate drenching gun. Weigh or estimate weight carefully, and dose the heaviest animal in a group at its own weight to avoid under-dosing. Under-dosing is one of the main causes of worms becoming resistant to dewormers. If you are not sure about the dose, the correct time to treat, or the withdrawal period for milk and meat, ask your vet or animal health provider. GOOD PRACTICE • Deworm on a programme agreed with your vet, rather than only when animals look sick • Keep clean water and good pasture management to reduce re-infection • Rotate dewormers from different groups when advised, to help slow resistance • Keep records of dates, products and doses SAFETY AND STORAGE For veterinary use. Follow the label dose and withdrawal periods. Wear gloves when handling and wash your hands afterwards. Keep out of reach of children. Store the bottle tightly closed in a cool, dry place away from direct sun and food. Do not let rinse water reach streams or ponds. item.title: Ampligo 150ZC Insecticide 100 ml
item.description: Ampligo 150ZC Insecticide (100 ml) Fall armyworm (viwavi jeshi) in the maize whorl and Tuta absoluta in tomatoes can finish a crop before you notice. Syngenta Ampligo 150 ZC combines two modes of action in one bottle: chlorantraniliprole stops caterpillars feeding almost at once, and lambda-cyhalothrin gives fast knockdown. It is registered in Kenya for maize, tomatoes, cabbage, French beans and snow peas. KEY BENEFITS • Two active ingredients from different chemical groups, so it works well in resistance-management rotations • Feeding stops quickly, so the crop stops being damaged • Long-lasting protection that holds up in rain • Controls caterpillars, aphids, thrips and whitefly nymphs on the crops listed on the label • Very low rates: 6 to 12 ml per 20 L knapsack TECHNICAL SPECS • Active ingredients: Chlorantraniliprole 100 g/L + Lambda-cyhalothrin 50 g/L • Formulation: Mixed capsule suspension and suspension concentrate (ZC) • WHO Class II (moderately hazardous), PCPB(CR)1702 • Shelf life: 2 years in the original sealed container • Pack: 100 ml MIXING AND APPLICATION DOSAGE (per 20 L knapsack) • Maize (fall armyworm): 10 to 12 ml (350 ml/ha in heavy infestation). Harvest wait: 14 days • French beans (aphids, thrips, whiteflies): 6 to 8 ml. Harvest wait: 7 days • Cabbage (diamondback moth, aphids): 12 ml. Harvest wait: 3 days • Snow peas (aphids, caterpillars, thrips): 12 ml. Harvest wait: 7 days • Tomatoes (Tuta absoluta, aphids, whitefly nymphs, thrips): 6 ml. Harvest wait: 3 days Spray timing: start at early infestation. Maize: repeat after 7 days, maximum 2 sprays per season. Other crops: repeat after 10 days, maximum 3 sprays per season. A 100 ml pack mixes about 8 to 16 knapsacks, depending on the crop rate. 1. Fill the knapsack 1/10 to 1/4 full with clean water and add the measured Ampligo. 2. Agitate while topping up, shake well before spraying and keep agitating while you spray. 3. Cover the maize whorl and the undersides of leaves. Do not spray in the hottest hours, on wet foliage, or when rain is expected within 2 hours. SAFETY Toxic to bees and fish. Do not spray flowering crops or near water. item.title: BioDistinction Extra 700SC Copper Fertilizer
item.description: Greenlife BioDistinction Extra 700SC Copper Fertilizer (1 Litre) Greenlife BioDistinction Extra 700SC is a liquid chelated copper suspension concentrate fertilizer. It contains copper oxychloride 700 g/L, which is 400 g/L metallic copper equivalent, and it corrects and prevents copper deficiency in vegetables, fruit, cereals and ornamentals. It is supplied in a 1 litre pack. KEY FEATURES • Liquid chelated copper fertilizer in suspension concentrate (SC) form • Copper oxychloride 700 g/L (400 g/L metallic copper equivalent) • Corrects and prevents copper deficiency • For vegetables, fruit, cereals and ornamentals • 1 litre pack • Greenlife brand WHY COPPER MATTERS Copper is a trace element that plants need in small amounts. It plays a part in enzyme activity, in the formation of chlorophyll and in flowering, pollen formation and grain filling. When copper is short, plants can show stunted growth, pale or twisted young leaves, poor flowering and lower yields. Cereals are especially sensitive, and deficiencies are more common in sandy, peaty and very high-organic soils. HOW TO USE IT Apply as directed on the label, normally as a foliar spray, using the dose and water volume recommended for your crop. Mix by half-filling the tank with water, adding the measured product, topping up and agitating well. Spray evenly, covering the leaves. Apply when the crop is actively growing and at the stage recommended on the label, and spray early in the morning or late in the afternoon when it is cooler. If you are unsure whether copper is really short, consider a soil or leaf test to confirm. GOOD PRACTICE • Do not exceed the label rate, because too much copper can harm plants and soil • Avoid spraying in hot midday sun • Test a small area first if you plan to mix with other products • Keep records of dates and doses SAFETY Read the label before use. Wear gloves, a mask, goggles and protective clothing when mixing and spraying, and wash well afterwards. Keep away from children, pets, food and water. Copper compounds can be harmful to fish and aquatic life, so keep spray and rinse water out of streams, ponds and drains. STORAGE Store in the original closed bottle in a cool, dry place away from food and feed. Shake well before use. item.title: Amaze Fridge and Freezer Guard with 6-Way Extension Socket
item.description: Buy the Amaze Fridge and Freezer Guard with a 6-way extension socket online in Kenya. Power cuts, sudden returns of electricity and low voltage are some of the most common reasons fridge compressors fail. This guard sits between your wall socket and your fridge or freezer, watches the supply, and cuts the power when it is unsafe so your appliance is not damaged. How it works: the guard has three indicator lights marked OFF, WAIT and ON. When the supply is unsafe it disconnects the appliance. When power returns, the guard waits for a short delay before switching back on, which gives the compressor time to settle. This protects against the damaging quick restart that often happens when electricity comes back after an outage. A bypass button lets you override the guard if you need to. The bundle also includes an Amaze 6-way extension socket with a long white cable and a UK-style plug, so you can power your TV, decoder, phone chargers and other small devices from a single wall point. The sockets are clearly spaced, and the cable is long enough to reach across most rooms. Who needs it: any household or small business with a fridge, freezer, water dispenser or display cooler. In areas where voltage drops or blackouts are common, a guard is a small cost compared with replacing a compressor or losing a freezer full of food, milk or drinks. Pack size: 1 Amaze fridge and freezer guard plus 1 Amaze 6-way extension socket with cable. Colour: white with blue label. Plug type: UK three-pin. Please check the rating printed on the guard against your appliance before you buy, and use the guard for refrigeration appliances as shown on its label. Installation is simple: plug the guard into the wall, plug your fridge into the guard, and wait for the ON light. No tools needed. Order today, choose pickup or delivery to your county, and pay with M-Pesa at checkout. item.description: Abasi 5% EC (500 ml) Spider mites, thrips and leafminers are small, but they reduce yield and spoil the look of roses, tomatoes, cucumbers and French beans, which is what buyers pay for. KEY BENEFITS • Strong knockdown of mites and leaf-mining insects • Contact and stomach activity stops pests feeding quickly • Translaminar movement protects both leaf surfaces • Reliable on thrips and other small sucking pests • Cost-efficient: only 4 to 6 ml per 20 L knapsack TECHNICAL SPECS • Active ingredient: Abamectin 5% (50 g/L) • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • IRAC group 6: activates glutamate-gated chloride channels, causing paralysis • Pack: 500 ml (also available in 50 ml, 100 ml, 250 ml, 500 ml and 1 L) • Crops and pests: thrips, spider mites and nematode dips on roses; spider mites and caterpillars on tomatoes; leafminers and aphids on cucumbers; leafminers, thrips, spider mites and aphids on French beans MIXING AND APPLICATION DOSAGE (per 20 L knapsack) Rate: 200 to 300 ml per hectare in 1,000 L of water, which is 4 to 6 ml per 20 L knapsack. A 500 ml pack mixes about 83 to 125 knapsacks. 1. Half-fill the knapsack with clean water. 2. Add the measured Abasi, then top up to 20 L and agitate well. 3. item.description: Actellic 50EC Insecticide (100 ml, 250 ml, 500 ml, 1 litre) Weevils and moths can turn a full store of maize into dust within months. It acts by contact, ingestion and fumigant action, and it keeps working on walls, floors and bag surfaces after you spray. KEY FEATURES • Controls weevils, beetles, moths, flies and wasps • Acts by contact, ingestion and fumigant action • Keeps working on treated walls, floors and bag surfaces • Three uses: store surface spray, bagged grain and grain admixture SPECIFICATIONS • Brand: Actellic • Product: 50EC insecticide • Active ingredient: Pirimiphos-methyl 500 g/L (49.02% w/w) • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • Chemical group: Organophosphate • Pack sizes: 100 ml, 250 ml, 500 ml, 1 litre WHERE IT HELPS Insects arrive with the harvest and hide in cracks, on walls and on bag surfaces, so the building needs treating as well as the grain. Actellic 50EC covers three jobs: surface spraying of stores and livestock houses, treating bagged grain, and mixing into stored grain as an admixture. MIXING RATES (FROM THE PRODUCT LABEL) • Walls, floors, empty stores and livestock houses: 100 ml in 10 L of water (200 ml per 20 L knapsack) • Bagged grain and bag stacks: 50 to 100 ml in 5 L of water per 100 m² (200 to 400 ml per 20 L knapsack). Use the higher end for an existing infestation • Admixture to stored grain: 8 ml per tonne of grain, diluted in 0.75 to 1.5 L of water (not mixed in the knapsack) • Coverage: about 5 L of spray per 100 m². BEFORE YOU START • Remove food, feed and animals before spraying • Ventilate the store afterwards • Measure the area first, so that you mix only the volume you need SAFETY Actellic 50EC is an organophosphate, so wear gloves, a mask and overalls when mixing and spraying, and keep children, pets, food, feed and water away. Label grain treated by admixture as chemically treated, and follow any waiting period on the pack. STORAGE Store the bottle closed, in its original container, in a cool, dry, locked place away from food and feed. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Which pests does Actellic 50EC control? The catalog lists weevils, beetles, moths, flies and wasps. Can I use Actellic 50EC in a thermal fogger? No. The catalog advice for this product is not to use it with thermal foggers. item.title: Albafas 10% Albendazole Drench 40 ml
item.description: Albafas 10% Albendazole Drench (40 ml) Albafas is a 10% w/v albendazole drench for treating worms and liver fluke in cattle, sheep, goats and camels. It is supplied in a 500 ml bottle from Norbrook Kenya, and it is used against roundworms, lungworms, tapeworms and liver fluke. KEY FEATURES • 10% w/v albendazole, a broad-spectrum dewormer • For cattle, sheep, goats and camels • Used against roundworms, lungworms, tapeworms and liver fluke • 500 ml bottle • Made by Norbrook Kenya WHY WORM CONTROL MATTERS Internal parasites quietly drain animals. Heavily infected cattle, sheep, goats and camels grow slowly, lose condition, produce less milk and meat, and become more open to other diseases. Young animals are often the most affected. Regular, well-planned deworming protects growth and productivity and can save the cost of treating sick animals later. HOW TO USE IT Albafas is given by mouth as a drench. The dose depends on the animal species and body weight, so follow the dose on the label and use an accurate drenching gun. Weigh or estimate weight carefully, and dose the heaviest animal in a group at its own weight to avoid under-dosing. Under-dosing is one of the main causes of worms becoming resistant to dewormers. If you are not sure about the dose, the correct time to treat, or the withdrawal period for milk and meat, ask your vet or animal health provider. GOOD PRACTICE • Deworm on a programme agreed with your vet, rather than only when animals look sick • Keep clean water and good pasture management to reduce re-infection • Rotate dewormers from different groups when advised, to help slow resistance • Keep records of dates, products and doses SAFETY AND STORAGE For veterinary use. Follow the label dose and withdrawal periods. Wear gloves when handling and wash your hands afterwards. Keep out of reach of children. Store the bottle tightly closed in a cool, dry place away from direct sun and food. Do not let rinse water reach streams or ponds. item.title: Albafas 10% Albendazole Drench 5 Litres
item.description: Albafas 10% Albendazole Drench (5 Litres) Albafas is a 10% w/v albendazole drench for treating worms and liver fluke in cattle, sheep, goats and camels. It is supplied in a 500 ml bottle from Norbrook Kenya, and it is used against roundworms, lungworms, tapeworms and liver fluke. KEY FEATURES • 10% w/v albendazole, a broad-spectrum dewormer • For cattle, sheep, goats and camels • Used against roundworms, lungworms, tapeworms and liver fluke • 500 ml bottle • Made by Norbrook Kenya WHY WORM CONTROL MATTERS Internal parasites quietly drain animals. Heavily infected cattle, sheep, goats and camels grow slowly, lose condition, produce less milk and meat, and become more open to other diseases. Young animals are often the most affected. Regular, well-planned deworming protects growth and productivity and can save the cost of treating sick animals later. HOW TO USE IT Albafas is given by mouth as a drench. The dose depends on the animal species and body weight, so follow the dose on the label and use an accurate drenching gun. Weigh or estimate weight carefully, and dose the heaviest animal in a group at its own weight to avoid under-dosing. Under-dosing is one of the main causes of worms becoming resistant to dewormers. If you are not sure about the dose, the correct time to treat, or the withdrawal period for milk and meat, ask your vet or animal health provider. GOOD PRACTICE • Deworm on a programme agreed with your vet, rather than only when animals look sick • Keep clean water and good pasture management to reduce re-infection • Rotate dewormers from different groups when advised, to help slow resistance • Keep records of dates, products and doses SAFETY AND STORAGE For veterinary use. Follow the label dose and withdrawal periods. Wear gloves when handling and wash your hands afterwards. Keep out of reach of children. Store the bottle tightly closed in a cool, dry place away from direct sun and food. Do not let rinse water reach streams or ponds. item.title: Bat CRP Bat Repellent 500 ml
item.description: Bat CRP Bat Repellent (250 ml, 500 ml and 1 litre) Bats that settle in a roof or ceiling leave droppings and urine that stain ceilings, cause strong smells and attract insects, and their noise at night disturbs families, guests and worshippers. Bat CRP is a heavy-duty bat repellent chemical for moving bats out of roofs, ceilings, halls and other hiding places. It is diluted with water as the label directs and comes in 250 ml, 500 ml and 1 litre packs. KEY FEATURES • Heavy-duty bat repellent chemical • For roofs, ceilings, halls and other roosting places • Label dilution for roofing and hall areas: 1 part product to 4 parts water • Three pack sizes: 250 ml, 500 ml and 1 litre • Delivered to all 47 counties SPECIFICATIONS • Product: Bat CRP Bat Repellent • Use: Roofs, ceilings, halls and other roosting places • Pack sizes: 250 ml, 500 ml, 1 litre WHERE IT HELPS Droppings build up in roof spaces, and the smell and stains spread to the rooms below. Halls, churches, schools, hotels, offices and homes often need a way to move bats out. Bat CRP is made for that job: you apply the diluted mixture where bats roost, so that they leave and look elsewhere. DILUTION (FROM THE PRODUCT LABEL) • Roofing and hall areas: 1 part Bat CRP to 4 parts water • Always confirm the dilution on your pack's label before mixing HOW TO USE IT Dilute Bat CRP with water as directed on the label. Apply the diluted mixture to the places where bats roost, such as the underside of roofs, ceiling spaces, beams and corners. Treat the roosting surfaces thoroughly and repeat if the label advises. Once the bats have left, close the entry points so they cannot return: seal the eaves, gaps around the roof, vents and holes in walls. Then clean up droppings safely and keep the roof space dry and clean. BEFORE YOU START • Clear old droppings and wear protective gear first, because dried droppings can create dust • Check local rules on handling bats if you are unsure SAFETY Read the label before use. Wear gloves, a mask, goggles and protective clothing when mixing and applying, and use a ladder or platform safely when working at height. Wash your hands after use and keep out of reach of children. Keep away from food, water, pets and livestock, and do not let the product reach streams or ponds. STORAGE Store in the original closed container in a cool, dry, locked place. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS What is Bat CRP used for? It is a heavy-duty bat repellent chemical for roofs, ceilings, halls and other places where bats roost in homes and buildings. How do I dilute it? Dilute it with water as directed on the label. For roofing and hall areas, the label dilution is 1 part product to 4 parts water. What should I do after the bats have gone? Close the entry points, clean up droppings safely and keep the roof space dry. Will it harm the bats? It is a repellent. Bats are useful outdoors because they eat insects, so the aim is to move them out of buildings. Check local rules if unsure. item.title: Actellic 50EC Insecticide 500 ml
item.description: Actellic 50EC Insecticide (100 ml, 250 ml, 500 ml, 1 litre) Weevils and moths can turn a full store of maize into dust within months. Actellic 50EC is an organophosphate emulsifiable concentrate with pirimiphos-methyl 500 g/L. It acts by contact, ingestion and fumigant action, and it keeps working on walls, floors and bag surfaces after you spray. KEY FEATURES • Controls weevils, beetles, moths, flies and wasps • Acts by contact, ingestion and fumigant action • Keeps working on treated walls, floors and bag surfaces • Three uses: store surface spray, bagged grain and grain admixture SPECIFICATIONS • Brand: Actellic • Product: 50EC insecticide • Active ingredient: Pirimiphos-methyl 500 g/L (49.02% w/w) • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • Chemical group: Organophosphate • Pack sizes: 100 ml, 250 ml, 500 ml, 1 litre WHERE IT HELPS Insects arrive with the harvest and hide in cracks, on walls and on bag surfaces, so the building needs treating as well as the grain. Actellic 50EC covers three jobs: surface spraying of stores and livestock houses, treating bagged grain, and mixing into stored grain as an admixture. MIXING RATES (FROM THE PRODUCT LABEL) • Walls, floors, empty stores and livestock houses: 100 ml in 10 L of water (200 ml per 20 L knapsack) • Bagged grain and bag stacks: 50 to 100 ml in 5 L of water per 100 m² (200 to 400 ml per 20 L knapsack). Use the higher end for an existing infestation • Admixture to stored grain: 8 ml per tonne of grain, diluted in 0.75 to 1.5 L of water (not mixed in the knapsack) • Coverage: about 5 L of spray per 100 m². Porous surfaces such as concrete, brick and unpainted wood may need up to 15 L per 100 m² • One 20 L tank covers roughly 400 m² on normal surfaces and about 130 m² on porous ones HOW TO USE IT Clean and sweep the store first, removing old grain and debris, then spray to wet all surfaces without run-off. For admixture, dilute the measured amount in the water volume shown and apply it to the grain, not in the knapsack. These are the rates the catalog already published for this product, so check them against the label on your pack before mixing. Do not use Actellic 50EC with thermal foggers. BEFORE YOU START • Remove food, feed and animals before spraying • Ventilate the store afterwards • Measure the area first, so that you mix only the volume you need SAFETY Actellic 50EC is an organophosphate, so wear gloves, a mask and overalls when mixing and spraying, and keep children, pets, food, feed and water away. Label grain treated by admixture as chemically treated, and follow any waiting period on the pack. STORAGE Store the bottle closed, in its original container, in a cool, dry, locked place away from food and feed. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Which pests does Actellic 50EC control? The catalog lists weevils, beetles, moths, flies and wasps. Can I use Actellic 50EC in a thermal fogger? No. The catalog advice for this product is not to use it with thermal foggers. How much does one 20 L knapsack cover? About 400 m² on normal surfaces and roughly 130 m² on porous ones such as concrete, brick and unpainted wood. item.description: Actellic 50EC Insecticide (100 ml, 250 ml, 500 ml, 1 litre) Weevils and moths can turn a full store of maize into dust within months. Actellic 50EC is an organophosphate emulsifiable concentrate with pirimiphos-methyl 500 g/L. It acts by contact, ingestion and fumigant action, and it keeps working on walls, floors and bag surfaces after you spray. KEY FEATURES • Controls weevils, beetles, moths, flies and wasps • Acts by contact, ingestion and fumigant action • Keeps working on treated walls, floors and bag surfaces • Three uses: store surface spray, bagged grain and grain admixture SPECIFICATIONS • Brand: Actellic • Product: 50EC insecticide • Active ingredient: Pirimiphos-methyl 500 g/L (49.02% w/w) • Formulation: Emulsifiable concentrate (EC) • Chemical group: Organophosphate • Pack sizes: 100 ml, 250 ml, 500 ml, 1 litre WHERE IT HELPS Insects arrive with the harvest and hide in cracks, on walls and on bag surfaces, so the building needs treating as well as the grain. Actellic 50EC covers three jobs: surface spraying of stores and livestock houses, treating bagged grain, and mixing into stored grain as an admixture. These are the rates the catalog already published for this product, so check them against the label on your pack before mixing. Do not use Actellic 50EC with thermal foggers. BEFORE YOU START • Remove food, feed and animals before spraying • Ventilate the store afterwards • Measure the area first, so that you mix only the volume you need SAFETY Actellic 50EC is an organophosphate, so wear gloves, a mask and overalls when mixing and spraying, and keep children, pets, food, feed and water away. Label grain treated by admixture as chemically treated, and follow any waiting period on the pack. STORAGE Store the bottle closed, in its original container, in a cool, dry, locked place away from food and feed. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Which pests does Actellic 50EC control? item.title: Bayer Baraki Pellets Rat and Mice Poison 100 g
item.description: Bayer Baraki Pellets Rat and Mice Poison, 100 g pack Rats gnaw wiring, foul food stores and spread disease, and a few quickly become many. Bayer Baraki Pellets are a ready-to-use rodenticide bait made for single-feed control: rats and mice need to eat the bait only once. The pellets contain difethialone, an anticoagulant, and need no mixing. Baraki comes as a 10 g sachet, a 100 g pack and a 1 kg box. This listing is the 100 g pack, about 10 sachets of 10 g. At the placement amounts below it fills roughly one to two rat stations or about 5 to 6 mouse stations, which suits a shop, a store or a home with several bait points. KEY FEATURES • Single-feed anticoagulant bait for roof rats, Norway rats and house mice • Mould and moisture resistant, so it stays attractive in damp stores • Sold as effective against resistant strains • Suited to homes, markets, farms and industrial sites SPECIFICATIONS • Brand: Bayer • Product: Baraki Pellets Rat and Mice Poison • Type: Anticoagulant rodenticide bait pellets (difethialone) • Pack sizes: 10 g sachet, 100 g, 1 kg box WHERE IT HELPS Rodents chew wiring, sacks and packaging, eat and spoil stored food, and leave droppings and urine that spread germs. Roof rats climb into ceilings and stores, Norway rats burrow along walls and drains, and house mice nest in small hidden spaces, so the places to bait differ. Pellets that resist mould and moisture help in damp stores and farm buildings, where loose bait goes off quickly. PLACEMENT AMOUNTS (NO MIXING) • Rats: 50 to 75 g per station (about 5 to 7 sachets of 10 g), one station every 5 to 10 m along walls, rat runs, burrows and sheltered areas • Mice: 15 to 20 g per station (about 2 sachets of 10 g), one station every 2 to 4 m along walls, runways and nests • A 100 g pack is about 10 sachets of 10 g, and a 1 kg box is about 100 sachets HOW TO USE IT Inspect first for droppings, gnaw marks, runs and burrows, so you know where the rodents travel. Place the bait in covered bait stations or tamper-resistant boxes, never loose on the floor. Check every 2 to 3 days and top up until feeding stops. Wearing gloves, collect dead rodents and dispose of them safely. BEFORE YOU START • Block holes and gaps around pipes, doors and roof edges • Store grain, feed and food in closed containers, off the floor • Remove rubbish and clutter that give rodents shelter SAFETY This is a poison. Read the label before use and keep the bait out of reach of children, pets and poultry. Wear gloves and wash your hands after handling it. If a person or an animal swallows any, get medical or veterinary help immediately and show the pack. STORAGE Keep sachets and packs closed in a dry, locked place, away from food, animal feed and children. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Which Baraki pack size should I buy? The 10 g sachet suits one room or a first trial. The 100 g pack suits a shop, a store or a home with several bait points, and the 1 kg box suits farms, markets and industrial sites. Does Baraki need mixing? No. The pellets are ready to use, so you simply place them in covered bait stations. How often should I check the stations? Every 2 to 3 days, topping up until feeding stops. Read the label on your pack as well. item.title: Actellic Gold Dust 100 g
item.description: Actellic Gold Dust (100 g, 500 g, 1 kg) Actellic Gold Dust is a ready-to-use dust for protecting stored grain from insect damage. It combines pirimiphos-methyl (16 g/kg) and thiamethoxam (3.6 g/kg) in a dustable powder, and it is registered in Kenya by the Pest Control Products Board (PCPB(CR) 1149). The 100 g, 500 g and 1 kg packs suit households and small farms storing maize and other cereals. KEY FEATURES • Ready to use, with no mixing in water • Two active ingredients working together against stored-grain pests • Registered in Kenya by the Pest Control Products Board • Three pack sizes: 100 g, 500 g and 1 kg • Suits household and small farm storage • Delivered to all 47 counties SPECIFICATIONS • Brand: Actellic • Product: Gold Dust grain protectant • Formulation: dustable powder • Active ingredients: pirimiphos-methyl 16 g/kg and thiamethoxam 3.6 g/kg • Registration: PCPB(CR) 1149 • Pack sizes: 100 g, 500 g, 1 kg WHERE IT HELPS The catalog lists the larger grain borer, grain weevil, red flour beetle, lesser grain borer and other stored-grain beetles and moths. These pests can ruin a harvest in a few months, hollowing out kernels, leaving dust and spoiling grain for food, seed and sale. A dust that goes in as the grain is stored keeps working inside the bag. RATE FROM THE PACK • About 50 g per 90 kg of grain, the size of a standard bag, as printed on the pack • Mix the dust evenly through the grain as it goes into storage • Do not use more than the label directs HOW TO USE IT Mix the dust evenly through the grain as it goes into storage. At the pack rate of about 50 g per 90 kg bag, a 100 g pack treats about two bags, a 500 g pack about ten and a 1 kg pack about twenty. Even mixing matters, because pests survive in untreated pockets, so turn the grain until the dust is spread through every bag. Follow the label exactly. BEFORE YOU START • Clean and dry the store, and use dry, clean bags • Remove old grain, sweep out dust and fix cracks where insects can hide • Make sure the grain is properly dry before storing, because damp grain spoils even when treated SAFETY Avoid breathing the dust, and wear a mask and gloves when mixing. Keep it away from children, pets and food, and wash your hands afterwards. Follow the label's waiting period before using treated grain, and do not rinse containers into water sources. STORAGE Keep the pack closed in a cool, dry place out of reach of children. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS What does Actellic Gold Dust protect against? Stored-grain pests such as the larger grain borer, grain weevil, red flour beetle and lesser grain borer, and other stored-grain beetles and moths. Do I mix it with water?
